title: a creation taken back on a superseded reading
line: a person the rule created from a death record, the creation taken back after the page was read again and its card left undecided on the superseded reading as an older matcher's, is no new person when reconsider matches the current reading again: the persona is put to the person the creation made, never a second one, and is the owner's card, since the son's one link to his mother is the record's own and no claim of the file's; accepted, the creation's statements, left undecided with its closed card, stand again with it

steps.say: the death record naming her as the deceased's mother, attached on the owner's word as hers
she is accepted by the owner: the son the record states she bore, whom nobody fits, is created by the rule
the page read again while the creation stands: his link carries to the new reading
the rule takes the creation back after the re-read: its card undecided again on the superseded reading, the person row staying
the record's open cards marked as an older matcher's: the rule leaves an older matcher's creation for reconsider to propose again

reconsider closes the card on the superseded reading and matches the current reading again: the persona is put to the person the creation made, never proposed as a new person, and stays the owner's: his name is no accepted fact, and his link to his mother is the record's own

expect.why: the card left on the superseded reading closes as a re-read closes the cards of the reading it supersedes
the current reading's persona of his entry, proposed as the person the creation made; the one link the tree holds of him is the one the creation wrote from this record, which claims nothing

has: the name is not accepted yet
neither accepted nor the file's own claim

expect.why: the record would be its own proof: the reason names the link and why it does not count
never a second Ollie Duke Davidson
the statements the withdrawal left undecided wait on the card

steps.say: the owner accepts him on the current reading

expect.why: the statements the withdrawal left undecided stand again with the decision on the current reading: closing a card judged nothing it stated
